subject: Partial-period invoice hold & VAT split request — Novapulse mid-cycle seat add
messages:
From: Sara Li <sara.li@novapulse.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: finance@novapulse.com
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Usage / seat add from Nov 12 — request to hold invoice until PO

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the call earlier. We added 6 additional seats on Nov 12 for our support team (trial -> paid). We noticed the invoice that posted yesterday included the full-month charge for those seats rather than a prorated amount. Can you confirm how the proration was calculated and — critically for our procurement — hold the posted invoice while we issue a PO? Our finance team needs the PO number on the invoice to trigger payment, and they will not pay until the PO is attached.

Also, we are EU-based and need VAT split information on the mid-cycle charge (we have a valid VAT registration but it isn't currently on the invoice). Could you reissue or credit the current invoice, apply the correct prorated charge for Nov 12–30 (inclusive), and show VAT (20%) separated so our AP system can reconcile?

I can attach the PO as soon as procurement finalizes it (aiming to send by EOD Monday). Appreciate a quick confirmation.

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Li
Head of Ops, Novapulse
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Sara Li <sara.li@novapulse.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 25 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Usage / seat add from Nov 12 — request to hold invoice until PO

Hi Sara — thanks for the note and for flagging this.

Quick summary / proposed path: 
- Why it looked like a full-month charge: our automated billing system invoices any seat adds that occur mid-cycle on the next invoice run and, in some cases, posts the unadjusted charge pending PO/metadata. That said, we absolutely will correct this.
- Proposed correction: we will void the posted invoice, issue a credit note for the full-month portion, and generate an adjusted invoice that contains the prorated seat charge for Nov 12–30 plus VAT (20%) shown as a separate line.
- Action we need from you: a scanned PO (PDF) with the PO number and your VAT registration number. Once we have the PO, Finance will attach it to the invoice and unlock payment.
- Timing: if we receive the PO by EOD Monday (11/30) we can issue the credit note and adjusted invoice the same day — you'll see two documents: Credit Note CN-20261130.pdf and Adjusted Invoice 20261130.pdf (we'll also include a short calc sheet).

For transparency, the prorate math we will use (example): 6 seats × $120/mo = $720 full month. Days charged = 19 of 30 (Nov 12–30 inclusive) => prorated net = $720 × 19/30 = $456. VAT 20% on net = $91.20. Total = $547.20.

If you'd prefer we net the credit against the posted invoice instead of voiding and reissuing, let me know — either approach is fine as long as your AP receives a document with the PO and VAT breakdown.

Cc-ing Monica from Billing to expedite.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive — Redwood Inference

Can we get sign-off to hold the invoice (mark as 'awaiting PO' in billing) and route the credit note issuance through Finance today if PO arrives by 11/30? This avoids dunning and keeps their AP workflow moving.

Thanks — Marissa
